name: Piled foundation with pile caps
summary: Set out and drive piles, test their integrity, survey as-built positions, excavate and pour pile caps with a cure watch.

steps.note: Piling near live services or plant needs a permit
Integrity testing of a sample of piles
As-built pile positions and levels, check against the pile cap design
Excavate to cap level and trim pile heads

logic.reason: Allow heave and testing before the cap is cast

checks: Working platform designed for the rig
Pile set-out checked by a second person
Integrity test results before cap reinforcement
references: Piling construction guidance (bored and driven piles, working platforms)
Concrete construction guidance (formwork, placing, curing, hot and cold weather concreting)
